subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. When should white clothes be washed? (a) Tuesday (b) Monday (c) Sunday (d) Saturday ii. Where should color clothes be dried after washing? (a) On the floor (b) On the stone heap (c) On the clothesline (d) Inside a basket iii. What must be avoided while walking in the sun? (a) Bare-head (b) Shoes (c) Umbrella (d) Scarf iv. What is the advice about buying cotton for a blouse? (a) It must be cheap (b) It should have gum (c) It must be colorful (d) It should not have gum v. What should be done with salt fish before cooking? (a) Boil it directly (b) Fry it (c) Soak it overnight (d) Cut it dry vi. What is the girl warned not to sing in Sunday school? (a) Lullaby (b) Love song (c) Benna (d) Anthem vii. What should not be eaten on the street to avoid flies? (a) Meat (b) Fruits (c) Rice (d) Sweets
